articles.summary: Presentation Mode gives every presentation someone to give it. Hand a PAL your deck or materials and it presents them live, walking the full story from start to finish or pulling up the right slide the moment a question calls for it. The demo answers with the exact diagram, the talk your team gives over and over becomes a conversation anyone can start at any hour, and the weekly readout runs itself. The material your team already made no longer waits for a person to be free before it can be understood.
articles.title: Presentation Mode Gives Every Deck A PAL To Explain It

articles.summary: Magic Canvas gives every PAL a shared, interactive canvas inside the conversation. The PAL brings up the right component at just the right moment, a chart dynamically drawn from the numbers being discussed, a question answered on the spot, a calendar with times to pick, a field for the detail that must be exact. Whatever the person does with it, the PAL sees it instantly and responds in real time, so seeing what it means and getting things done happen in the same place the talking always has. The interface finally follows the conversation, instead of the other way around.
articles.title: Magic Canvas Lets A Conversation Finish What It Starts

articles.summary: Voice and text assistants miss what faces communicate. See how full-stack AI humans close that gap in healthcare, onboarding, and beyond.
articles.title: Virtual Assistants Are Getting Faces: The Shift to Visual AI

articles.summary: PALs can now join Google Meet. Invite one the way you'd invite any teammate — or drop it into a live call — and it's there as a real participant: on camera, following the conversation, and responding in real time. It can take notes in your team sync, ride along on sales calls, walk a customer through a technical demo, or host your standup, bringing the help into the meetings you already run instead of asking anyone to go somewhere new. It's human computing meeting you where you are, and Google Meet is just the first door — Zoom and Microsoft Teams are next.
articles.title: PALs Can Now Enter And Interact in Google Meet
